description: This file defines the NestedSetInterface interface in the OrangeHRM ORM subsystem, specifying method signatures for nested set operations related to hierarchical data management.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Retrieves the left boundary value of the nested set node, or null if not set.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the left boundary value of the nested set node.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Retrieves the right boundary value of the nested set node, or null if not set.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the right boundary value of the nested set node.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the level (depth) of the nested set node, or null if not set.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the level (depth) of the nested set node.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves the NodeInterface instance associated with this nested set node.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Associates a NodeInterface instance with this nested set node.
